provenance.current_plan_rule: Parent panels 1 and 2 are byte-equivalent JSON values in the current plan; replace only panel 3 with revised_final.

topic: Create exactly three vertically arranged panels explaining a team's release workflow in claymation style. Panel 1: Prepare - run tests and review the changelog. Panel 2: Verify - install the build in an isolated environment and exercise the main workflow. Panel 3: Release - publish the checked build and retain rollback instructions. Use only these facts; no invented metrics.
feedback: Revise the retained three-panel release workflow: replace the final heading Release with Ship with confidence, and add Keep the previous build available beneath the rollback instruction. Preserve the three-panel order and claymation look.

parent_panels.title: 1. Prepare
parent_panels.visual: A clay workbench in a miniature workshop. One sculpted developer figure stands at the bench running tests on a small clay device with a checklist card. A second figure holds a changelog scroll and reads it under a soft desk lamp. Props include a test tray with labeled tubes and a stack of changelog pages. The scene is warm and orderly, establishing the start of the workflow.

parent_panels.title: 2. Verify
content: Install the build in an isolated environment
parent_panels.visual: A sealed clay glass enclosure sits at the center of the set, representing the isolated environment. A sculpted figure places a small build block inside through a hatch. Inside the enclosure, a tiny clay figure walks through the main workflow along a marked path of stepping stones. Outside, a second figure watches through the glass holding a clipboard. Props include a padlock-style latch, a workflow track, and a checkmark card.

parent_panels.title: 3. Release
parent_panels.visual: A small clay loading dock with a launch ramp. A sculpted figure carries the verified build block up the ramp and sets it onto a publishing platform. A second figure files a rollback instructions binder into a labeled clay cabinet beside the platform, keeping it within reach. Props include a publish flag, a shipping crate marked as the checked build, and a rollback folder tab. The scene closes the workflow with clear, completed actions.

revised_final.title: 3. Ship with confidence
revised_final.visual: A small clay loading dock with a launch ramp. A sculpted figure carries the verified build block up the ramp and sets it onto a publishing platform. A second figure files a rollback instructions binder into a labeled clay cabinet beside the platform, keeping it within reach. Beneath the rollback instructions label, a lower clay shelf holds a previous build crate with a small tactile sign reading Keep the previous build available, placed so the figure's hand rests near it. Props include a publish flag, a shipping crate marked as the checked build, and a rollback folder tab. The scene closes the workflow with clear, completed actions.
